UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the system.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Authentication.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a project managed by authorized admins and displayed publicly.

title.description: The official title of the project.

description.description: A detailed description of the project's goals, methods, and outcomes.

status.description: The publication status of the project (e.g., 'draft', 'active', 'archived').

tags.description: A list of tags or keywords categorizing the project (e.g., 'Rocketry', 'CubeSat').

projectUrl.description: An optional external link for the project (GitHub, docs, website).

imageUrl.description: A URL for the project's main image (stored in Firebase Storage).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

Role.title: User Role
Role.description: Represents a user's assigned role and related metadata.

grantedBy.description: The UID of the user who granted this role.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when the role was granted.

scopedProjects.description: For roles like 'team_leader', an array of project IDs they are responsible for.

Blog.title: Blog Post
Blog.description: Represents a blog post or news article.

title.description: The title of the blog post.

body.description: The main content of the blog post.

authorUid.description: The UID of the user who authored the blog post.

authorName.description: The display name of the author.

published.description: Whether the blog post is published (true) or a draft (false).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the blog post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the blog post was last updated.

AuditLog.title: Audit Log Entry
AuditLog.description: Records significant actions and changes within the system for auditing purposes.

actorUid.description: The UID of the user who performed the action.

targetUidOrResource.description: The UID of the user or ID of the resource affected by the action.

payload.description: A JSON object containing additional details relevant to the action.

meta.description: Optional metadata, such as client IP or user agent.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents an event organized by SEDS.

description.description: A detailed description of the event.

date.description: The date and time of the event.

location.description: The location where the event will take place.

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who created the event.

published.description: Whether the event is published (true) or a draft (false).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the event was last updated.

TimelineEvent.title: Timeline Event
TimelineEvent.description: Represents a public timeline milestone shown on the homepage.

title.description: Short title for the timeline event.

icon.description: Icon identifier/name used by the UI (e.g., 'rocket', 'code').

date.description: Canonical timestamp used for chronological sorting.

RoleRequest.title: Role Request
RoleRequest.description: Represents a user's request for a specific role.

requesterUid.description: The UID of the user requesting the role.

status.description: The current status of the role request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the role request was created.

handledBy.description: The UID of the admin/superadmin who handled the request.

handledAt.description: Timestamp when the role request was handled.

notes.description: Optional notes provided by the requester or handler.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: Represents an invitation to join the SEDS Pakistan website.

email.description: Optional email to pre-fill for the invitee.

role.description: The role to assign when the invite is accepted.

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who created the invite.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invite was created.

usedBy.description: The UID of the user who claimed the invite.

usedAt.description: Timestamp when the invite was claimed.

revokedBy.description: The UID of the user who revoked the invite.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when the invite was revoked.

revoked.description: Whether the invite has been revoked.

/roles/{userId}.description: Stores user role assignments and metadata.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Stores audit log entries for system actions.

/timeline/{eventId}.description: Stores public timeline milestones for the homepage journey section.
